description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller named ContentPagesController, responsible for managing content pages within an admin panel of a web application. It includes methods for listing, creating, viewing details, removing, retrieving, saving, and validating content pages, specifically of type PAGE. The class interacts with content service and language service, manages Content and ContentDescription entities, and handles HTTP requests related to content page administration.

classes.name: ContentPagesController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing content pages in the admin interface. Handles CRUD operations and validation for content pages.

methods.name: listContentPages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all content pages. Sets the menu and displays the content pages list view.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Handles GET requests to create a new content page. Initializes a new Content object with default settings and available languages.

methods.name: getContentDetails
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific content page by ID. Validates ownership and content type, then loads descriptions for each language.

methods.name: removeContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a content page by ID via AJAX. Checks ownership and returns JSON response.

methods.name: pageStaticContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch and list content of a specific type (PAGE or BOX) for display via AJAX.

methods.name: saveContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a content page. Sets up descriptions with correct language and persists the entity.

methods.name: checkContentCode
methods.description: Handles POST requests to ensure the uniqueness of a content code, considering existing content with the same code.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private utility method to set the current menu state in the model for UI rendering.
